newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares off lows, further losses limited.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares off lows, further losses limited.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Shares ended off their lows but the subsequent weaker tone to Wall Street raised question marks about the market's direction on Tuesday, traders said.
*However, traders did not expect a repeat of the sharp sell-off seen at Monday's opening when the Lisbon exchange, which was closed on Friday, reacted to Friday's slump on Wall Street.
*Some shares were given a lift by the Bank of Portugal's surprise decision to shave 20 basis points off interest rates on Monday.

*But utility group EDP, the largest stock on the market, closed a hefty 2.4 percent down at 3,122 escudos, while Portugal Telecom also fell slightly further than the overall market, closing 1.6 percent down at 7,293 escudos.
*The PSI20 index ended 1.23 percent down at 8,153.94. Overall turnover was some 13 billion escudos.
